# FilestoreCloud Documentation

> Enterprise multi-tenant Nextcloud SaaS platform on AWS.
> Zero-Code-Modification architecture using ECS Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, EFS, S3, and Amazon Bedrock.

## Architecture

- [Introduction](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/introduction): Platform overview, repo map, architecture summary
- [Architecture Overview](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/architecture-overview): Infrastructure stack, CloudFormation modules, tenant isolation
- [Quickstart](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/quickstart): Deploy and provision first tenant in 5 steps

## Deployment

- [Prerequisites](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/deployment/prerequisites): Tools, AWS config, GitHub secrets
- [GitHub Actions CI/CD](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/deployment/github-actions): OIDC-based automated deployment
- [Local CLI](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/deployment/local-cli): scripts/deploy.sh usage and stack names
- [Verification](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/deployment/verification): Health checks and test suite

## Tenant Management

- [Provisioning](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/tenants/provisioning): Python script + SSM runbook
- [Lifecycle](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/tenants/lifecycle): ACTIVE / SUSPENDED / DEPROVISIONED states
- [Isolation Model](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/tenants/isolation-model): DEDICATED_INSTANCE architecture and NIST RBAC
- [Suspension & Resumption](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/tenants/suspension-resumption): FinOps zero-cost hibernation

## Control Plane

- [Super Admin Console](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/control-plane/super-admin-console): React 18 + Refine admin UI
- [SSM Runbook](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/control-plane/ssm-runbook): prod-Tenant-Lifecycle-Operator document
- [DynamoDB Registry](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/control-plane/dynamodb-registry): Tenant metadata schema and queries
- [CloudWatch](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/control-plane/cloudwatch): Metrics, alarms, live telemetry

## AI Integration

- [Bedrock Integration](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/ai/bedrock-integration): Claude 3.5 Sonnet via LiteLLM sidecar
- [LiteLLM Bridge](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/ai/litellm-bridge): OpenAI-compatible proxy configuration
- [RAG Pipeline](https://filestorecloud.github.io/docs/docs/ai/rag-pipeline): Document Q&A with tenant-isolated context

## Repositories

- [aws_nextcloud](https://github.com/FilestoreCloud/aws_nextcloud): Main platform (IaC, scripts, docker, tests)
- [control-panel](https://github.com/FilestoreCloud/control-panel): Super admin React console
- [docs](https://github.com/FilestoreCloud/docs): Public documentation site
